body: R62 is pushed as 745a729. get_body_read now carries three NEW keys, all additive - nothing that existed before changed name, type or meaning, so U9 as written still reads correctly. Per region: phase, which is G17 InjuryPhase.phase() for a region with a live diagnosis and {} for one that is merely sore (never a synthesised cleared). On the read: phase_board, G17's whole board with governing_region / weeks_to_clear / weeks_to_clear_known / active / cleared / unreadable / unknown; and record, G16 InjuryHistory.summarize() over body_state.injury_log with diagnoses / weeks_lost / weeks_lost_known / unusable_rows / regions / repeat_sites. Ids and numbers only - weeks_to_compete_known and weeks_lost_known are what let the screen say NO DATE SET rather than print a zero. Digest research/R62_DIGEST.md; body_read_test.gd is 62 checks, 0 failures.
